title: Saudi Arabia challenged by Yemeni allies over ceding ground to Houthis
summary_full: Strategy of redeploying forces to try to relieve siege of Taiz and protect Aden comes as Islamist group makes steady gainsSaudi Arabia has been accused by anti-Houthi forces over its military strategy after its Yemeni allies withdrew troops from the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait and pulled back forces from parts of Marib in the central part of the country.The Saudi-backed government explained the repositioning by saying the strategic priority was to break the attritional siege on Taiz, Yemen’s third city, and to protect Aden, the southern port city in which the Saudi-backed and UN-recognised government is now based.
